round2.routeDependencies: None added. This round only changes classifyAuthorizedFlow() (a pure function), the existing /api/signin flow's recorded methodCategory (already present), and UI marker text. No route was added, removed or renamed, and lib/server.mjs was not touched.

changes.title: the scan projects a method's prompts into a public-safe shape
what: new export projectPrompts(prompts): keeps only type / key / message / options[].label / options[].value; drops placeholders, defaults, entered values, hints and every function
classifyMethod() gained the categories 'form' (a text/password prompt) and 'secret' (a password prompt)
the child scan now emits the prompts projection and a `runnable` flag (the method really carries an authorize function) instead of the raw `hasAuthorize` name
normalizeScan()/pluginMethods() carry the projection into the public API shape
changes.safety: The scan still never calls authorize(); the projection carries no value and no function, so nothing entered by a user can reach an API response.

changes.title: the real flow is classified from what authorize() returned
what: new export classifyAuthorizedFlow(authorized) -> { category, url, instructions } with category in browser | device | form | local | unknown
chooseBrowserMethod(methods, preferred) can now be told which method to use, by label or by object; without a preference the old first-match behavior is unchanged
startSignIn({ provider, proxy, single, methodLabel }) uses the chosen method and records the real category in the flow status (publicFlow().methodCategory)
rules: instructions naming a one-time code -> device
instructions naming a browser/web page -> browser
a url with silent instructions -> browser
no url + a declared text/password prompt -> form (password is secret)
no url + no typed prompt -> local (reuse a local session); never form
changes.safety: A URL-less flow (for example commandcode's cliSignIn, which returns url:'') is classified local, never browser and never form.

changes.title: the card markers are honest, in four languages
what: the card now names six kinds apart: browser / needs details (form) / local session / key / paste a token (secret) / way to confirm (pending)
a runnable oauth method whose label names no kind is 'pending': it IS offered and the card says the kind is confirmed when the sign-in starts
new per-provider wording: FORM_METHOD_FOUND, SECRET_METHOD_FOUND, PENDING_METHOD_FOUND (en / zh-Hans / zh-Hant / ja)
new i18n keys: providerMethodFormTag, providerMethodSecretTag, providerMethodPendingTag, providerMethodNote (all four languages)
the card's source line / note says: the page shown at sign-in is the source of truth
the add-account entry is offered for every signable method, not only for a browser-labelled one
changes.noFalseClaims: No wording claims a browser sign-in was identified for a method whose label does not say so.

changes.title: the site picker for a plugin with several runnable oauth methods
what: the merge carries signInMethods: the labels of the runnable, non-local oauth methods
the sign-in dialog shows a picker (a plain <select>, id="signin-method") when there is more than one, and hides it otherwise
the chosen label travels in POST /api/signin as the optional field methodLabel
the service passes methodLabel to startSignIn(), which picks the exact method; an unmatched label is an honest error, never a silent fallback
